course.title: Digital Logic Design
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Suppose, you need to design a digital system which needs 14 individual instructions (10) [CO2] and its accumulator size is 16. Calculate the sizes of other registers and memory, if maximum allocated memory size is 2048 words.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2023
